name: Kanegasaki (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Kanegasaki town emblem in white: a ring open at the top and bottom enclosing a stylised letter M.
history: Municipal flag of Kanegasaki, a town in Iwate Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 4 August 1971.

features.role: Kanegasaki town emblem — a ring open at the top and bottom enclosing a stylised letter M
